scope: reconciliation of previously screened verses; nonpublic and not comprehensive
methodology: Faithful preservation of original preliminary classifications. No primary Greek/Hebrew, critical-edition, or manuscript verification performed in this reconciliation. The 13 passage locators are research leads, not 13 verified textual parallels.

verses.summary: The passage describes rejection of some messengers and selective belief.
Acceptance of all messengers and promised reward; no distinct earlier narrative asserted.
Demand for a book from heaven, demand to see God, calf worship, and pardon.
Mount raised over covenant, entry through gate, Sabbath command.
Covenant-breaking, disbelief, killing prophets, hearts described as covered.
Accusation against Mary; historically sensitive and requires source-specific investigation.
Denial that Jesus was killed/crucified by the speakers; complex textual and interpretive comparison.
God raised Jesus; distinguish raising from ascension narratives and later exegesis.
People of the Book and belief in Jesus before death; interpretive ambiguity.
Prohibition of previously permitted foods due to wrongdoing; compare law and covenant narratives cautiously.
